Name: Alarms
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[i]Update to 1.6 thanks to mouahrara[/i]

This mod adds a menu to create highly-customizable repeating alarms to be triggered at specific times of day. The menu is opened by pressing a hotkey combination (default: [b]LeftShift + \[/b]).

You add timers by pressing the big green plus.

Alarms are saved in the mod's [b]assets [/b]folder for each save independently (you can manually edit them there as well).

Alarms can be deleted by pressing the red circle with the slash through it.

New alarms are disabled by default and must be enabled by pressing the box in the top left of the new alarm.

By default, new timers will trigger unconditionally every day at the time specified once enabled.

You can have alarms trigger every hour by setting the hour to [b]-1[/b].

You can have alarms trigger every ten minutes of the given hour by setting the minutes to [b]-1[/b].

You can prevent alarms from triggering in specific seasons by clicking on any of the four the season icons. Alarms will not trigger on greyed out seasons.

You can have alarms trigger on specific days of the week or month by clicking on the white texts. Selected days are green; if no day of a week or month is selected, the alarm will trigger on all days (default).

Notification text can be whatever you choose, limited in length in the menu text box (longer text can be entered directly into the save's json file).

Alarm sounds must be chosen from[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Audio#Sound] the game's built-in audio cues[/url] (unless you have a mod that lets you create custom audio cues).

You can change the default audio cue in the config.

[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
